title: fix: shorten brand icon upload help
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Moves upload instructions into the existing tooltip beside Brand icon URL.
- Removes the expiry and day-15 explanation.
- Supports hover, keyboard focus and tap without adding custom tooltip logic.
- Checked formatting with Biome 2.3.10 and git diff --check.

gist.headline: The tooltip knows
gist.blurb: Brand icon upload guidance has moved into the little tooltip already living beside the URL field. Less form clutter, same useful directions.
gist.summary: Moved Brand icon URL upload instructions into its existing accessible tooltip, supporting hover, keyboard focus, and tap while removing the longer expiry explanation from the form.
gist.impact: Community endpoint creators get compact, available-on-demand icon upload help without extra instructions taking up space in the editor.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli tidying a cozy community-endpoint settings desk: a retro URL field has a small glowing help icon that opens into a neat tooltip, while redundant paper instructions are composted into a code-plant pot. The visual metaphor is guidance becoming compact and accessible, with Polli wearing tiny librarian glasses.
